text: MultiStateTMLE framework nonparametric causal inference multistate event processes, built around stochastic intensity interventions, calibrated interventions, composite estimands, estimated using targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE) allowing flexible nuisance learning.

text: can install development version MultiStateTMLE GitHub :
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("BjarkeHautop/MultiStateTMLE")

title: Causal Inference for Multistate Event Processes via TMLE
text: pipeline three main steps: prepare.initial() fits initial (nuisance) hazard models process data (Cox, HAL, exponential), builds discrete product state space used internally. tmle.alpha.fun() targets initial fit stochastic intensity intervention (scaling shape process alpha, optionally combined intervention baseline treatment), returning TMLE estimate, standard error, (optionally) efficient influence curve. calibration.fun()/calibration.curve.fun() calibrate shape intervention target effect size, make.calibrated.contrasts() decomposes total treatment effect mediated calibrated contrasts. sim.generic() sim..data() (built top simevent) simulate multistate event history data, either user-specified process/effect specification, parameters previously fitted observed data.
code: library(MultiStateTMLE)

paste(paste0("(", gsub("FALSE|TRUE",                   "", gsub(":", "):(", hal.vars.dynamic)), ")"),                   collapse = "+"))), data = tmp.state), sparse = TRUE)            X.hal.dynamic <- title: Compute Q and clever covariates per id using a discrete-state backward recursion — compute.Q.clever.per.id
text: function expects time-ordered dt_id (rows single id) contains hazard columns named like P.<name>.<s> discovered process <name> state index s 1..S. uses product-space states table map state indices build successor mappings.

title: Compute Q and clever covariates per id using a discrete-state backward recursion — compute.Q.clever.per.id
code: compute.Q.clever.per.id(   dt_id,   states,   process.types = NULL,   P.prefix = "P.",   state.idx.col = "state",   parameter = "target",   process.deltas = NULL,   compute.clever = TRUE,   browse = FALSE,   browse2 = FALSE,   get.years.lost = FALSE,   years.lost.block.size = 10,   clever.by.state = FALSE )

title: Compute Q and clever covariates per id using a discrete-state backward recursion — compute.Q.clever.per.id
text: dt_id data.table time-ordered rows single id. Must contain columns hazards form P... states data.table enumerating product state space. Must S rows columns stateful process (named process) plus column state giving indices 1..S. process.types named character vector list describing discovered process type. Allowed values include: "terminal", "recurrent", "one.jump", "state--atrisk". omitted, small heuristic used. P.prefix prefix used hazard columns dt_id (default "P."). function looks columns matching ^P.prefix<name>.<s>$. state.idx.col name column dt_id holds state index (value 1..S). Default "state". parameter character: name target process/outcome. "target" (default), first discovered terminal/outcome name used. process.deltas optional numeric vector (length = number discovered processes). used internally mapping, validated provided. compute.clever logical; whether compute append clever.Q.0 / clever.Q.1 (default TRUE). browse logical; TRUE, drop browser() start backward recursion. browse2 logical; TRUE, drop browser() secondary breakpoint inside recursion. get.years.lost logical; whether also compute years-lost-type summary. years.lost.block.size block size used computing years-lost summary (get.years.lost = TRUE). clever..state logical; whether compute clever covariates state rather pooled.

title: Compute Q and clever covariates per id using a discrete-state backward recursion — compute.Q.clever.per.id
text: data.table: dt_id augmented column Q columns clever.Q.<name>0 clever.Q.<name>1 discovered name.

title: Compute Q and clever covariates per id using a discrete-state backward recursion — compute.Q.clever.per.id
code: # S = 1, single terminal process "D": Q_t collapses to the discrete-time # cumulative incidence 1 - prod(1 - h_s). h <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3) dt_id <- data.table::data.table(   state = c(1L, 1L, 1L),   state.row.index = c(1L, 1L, 1L),   P.D.1 = h ) states <- data.table::data.table(state = 1L)  compute.Q.clever.per.id(   dt_id = dt_id,   states = states,   process.types = list(D = "terminal") ) #>    state state.row.index P.D.1     Q clever.Q.D0 clever.Q.D1 clever.Q.D   Q.1 #>    <int>           <int> <num> <num>       <num>       <num>      <num> <num> #> 1:     1               1   0.1 0.496        0.44           1       0.56 0.496 #> 2:     1               1   0.2 0.440        0.30           1       0.70 0.440 #> 3:     1               1   0.3 0.300        0.30           1       0.70 0.300

what: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
title: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
text: Searches shape-parameter intervention alpha value fun(alpha, ...)'s estimate equals theta, via bracket expansion followed root finding, caching evaluations fun along way.

title: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
code: estimate.alpha.fun(   theta,   fun,   c_n,   alpha_init = 1,   expand_up = 2,   expand_down = 0.25,   max_iter = 100,   alpha_min = 0.001,   alpha_max = 100,   use.cores = 50,   verbose = FALSE,   trace_every = 1L )

title: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
text: theta numeric; target value estimand solve . fun function alpha (plus ...) returning list estimate element eic element, e.g. tmle.alpha.fun(). c_n numeric; finite tolerance/scale constant used judge convergence (required, default). alpha_init numeric; initial value alpha evaluate. expand_up multiplicative factor used expand bracket upward. expand_down multiplicative factor used expand bracket downward. max_iter maximum number root-finding iterations. alpha_min lower bound alpha (must > 0). alpha_max upper bound alpha (must > alpha_min). use.cores number cores pass fun. verbose logical; TRUE, print progress every trace_every evaluations. trace_every integer; frequency (evaluations) progress output verbose = TRUE.

title: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
text: list describing solution, including selected alpha corresponding evaluation fun.

title: Search for the alpha achieving a target estimand value — estimate.alpha.fun
code: # Psi_z^alpha(P) = 0.6 * (1 - exp(-alpha)), with a known inverse, # used here to check that estimate.alpha.fun recovers it numerically. # eic mimics a real per-subject efficient influence curve, as returned # by tmle.alpha.fun(). set.seed(1405) fun <- function(alpha) {   psi <- 0.6 * (1 - exp(-alpha))   n <- 200   ic <- rnorm(n, sd = 0.05)   ic <- ic - mean(ic)   list(estimate = c(tmle.est = psi, se = sd(ic) / sqrt(n)), eic = ic) }  res <- estimate.alpha.fun(theta = 0.3, fun = fun, c_n = 1e-4, alpha_init = 1) res$alpha.hat #> [1] 0.6932652 res$converged #> [1] TRUE

),   verbose = FALSE ) #> Error in mclapply(state.chunks, function(state.chunk) {    chunk.out <- data.table(row_id = tmp.state[["row_id"]])    chunk.out[["state"]] <- 0    for (state.jj in state.chunk) {        if (verbose & (state.jj %in% print.state.jj)) {            print(paste0(state.jj, "/", max(depend.matrix[["state"]])))        }        depend.matrix.jj <- depend.matrix[state == state.jj]        which.jj <- rep(TRUE, nrow(tmp.state))        for (varname in setdiff(names(depend.matrix), "state")) {            tmp.state[[varname]] <- depend.matrix.jj[[varname]]            if `:=`((paste0(varname, ".",                         count.jj)), (tmp.state[[varname]] >=                         count.jj))]                    }                  }                }            }            which.jj <- which.jj & (tmp.long[[varname]] >= tmp.state[[varname]])        }        if (any.hal) {            X.hal.dynamic <- Matrix(model.matrix(formula(paste0("delta",                 "~-1+", paste(paste0("(", gsub("FALSE|TRUE",                   "", gsub(":", "):(", hal.vars.dynamic)), ")"),                   collapse = "+"))), data = tmp.state), sparse = TRUE)            X.hal.dynamic <- flip.interactions(X.hal.dynamic,                 hal.vars.dynamic)            if (length(hal.vars.A0.dynamic) > 0) {                X.hal.A0.dynamic <- Matrix(model.matrix(formula(paste0("delta",    sparse = TRUE)                X.hal.A0.dynamic <- flip.interactions(X.hal.A0.dynamic,                   hal.vars.A0.dynamic)            }            X.full <- cbind(X.hal.static, X.hal.dynamic, ".", names(fit.types)[fit.type.jj],                   ".", state.jj)            }            else {                colname <- paste0("P.", names(fit.types)[fit.type.jj],                   ".", state.jj)            }            if (fit.types[[fit.type.jj]]$fit == "hal") {                hal.index <- (1:length(which.hal))[names(which.hal) ==                   names(fit.types)[fit.type.jj]]                chunk.out[[colname]] <- as.numeric(exp(predict(fit.hals[[hal.index]][["hal.fit"]],                   X.full[, hal.vars.list[[hal.index]]], newoffset = 0,                   s =
